rows.title: Clarification - Financial Results
rows.summary: The Exchange has sought clarification from Shankara Building Products Limited for the quarter ended 30-Jun-2026 with respect to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. On basis of above the Company is required to clarify the following:  The response of the Company is awaited.

rows.title: Public Announcement-Open Offer
rows.summary: Corporate Professionals Capital Private Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of offer opening public announcement and corrigendum to the detailed public statement under Regulation 18(7) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 (SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011) for the attention of the shareholders of the Shankara Building Products Limited (Target Company).
